catalog-model.json.purpose: GET /model/{author}/{slug} snapshot: canonical slug, text modalities, structured outputs + reasoning capability, top provider budgets

catalog-endpoints.json.purpose: GET /models/{author}/{slug}/endpoints snapshot: unique 'testhost' endpoint, 'regionhost' base-slug ambiguity pair, EU variant missing structured_outputs for endpoint-level capability gate

success.json.purpose: finish_reason=stop, clean direct routing metadata in the official nested endpoints.available[] shape, full usage incl cache_write/reasoning/cost; parses to a single object

success-with-reasoning.json.purpose: message carries reasoning + reasoning_details even though exclude=true; raw artifact must redact the text, secret scan must pass

length.json.purpose: finish_reason=length -> INCOMPLETE/MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, partial content preserved, JSON never guessed

content-filter.json.purpose: finish_reason=content_filter -> REFUSED/SAFETY_REFUSAL, provider text only in visible artifact

tool-calls.json.purpose: finish_reason=tool_calls though request has no tools -> OUTPUT_PARSE_FAILED/TOOL_USE, not executed

empty-content.json.purpose: stop with empty content -> retryable PROVIDER_ERROR openrouter.empty_content

invalid-json.json.purpose: stop with markdown-fenced invalid JSON -> OUTPUT_PARSE_FAILED, adapter must not strip fences or repair

non-object-root.json.purpose: stop with a JSON array root -> OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID

resolved-model-mismatch.json.purpose: resolved model not in the allowlist (legacy flat endpoints array) -> R4: wire success, conformance gateway/upstream model mismatch; no prefix acceptance

usage-missing.json.purpose: success with no usage object -> all token fields null with a single limitation

usage-zeros.json.purpose: success with explicit zero usage incl cost=0 -> zeros preserved, no limitation

top-error-200.json.purpose: HTTP 200 body carrying a top-level error object -> error_type wins over status, status_mismatch=true

choice-embedded-error.json.purpose: HTTP 200 with choice-level embedded error + partial content -> embedded error classified, partial content not parsed

multiple-choices.json.purpose: two choices -> OUTPUT_PARSE_FAILED choice cardinality, both visible items kept
